I'll attach a consolidated "RFI Appendix" (draft) with specific artifact links and a one-page pen-test executive summary. Marissa / Diego — please scan the SLA wording and the SBOM/export options; flag any language we should tighten for procurement.

Thanks for the ping — quick internal notes (keeping it tight for procurement language):

1) Patch SLA wording
- "Critical / actively exploited" (P0): Initial triage within 24 hours; mitigation/temporary workaround within 72 hours; full remediation or formal mitigation plan within 14 calendar days.
- "High" (P1): Acknowledge within 48 hours; remediation within 30 calendar days where engineering-level changes required.
- "Medium/Low" (P2/P3): Prioritized by release cadence; tracked with SLA-of-effort and published patch schedule.

We should avoid committing to absolute remediation durations for customer-managed dependencies — instead commit to triage & advisory timelines and to providing SBOM + recommended upgrade paths.

2) SAST/DAST & false positives
- SAST: we run scheduled scans on mainline (weekly for core infra, nightly for SDKs). We generate a curated findings report that suppresses known benign patterns and annotates false positives.
- DAST: quarterly external scans + targeted scans for major releases. Partner performs authenticated scans for production endpoints.

3) SBOM cadence & format
- Default delivery: monthly SPDX + CSV export containing package, version, source, license, and SHA. We can add CycloneDX on request. Provide historical snapshots for 90 days on request.

4) Pen test summary
- Executive summary attached is sanitized for customer consumption; full report requires NDA and an evidence request playbook.

If Diego can confirm the export path for SBOM and the storage TTL, we can finalize Appendix A and send to Alex with a DocuSign link.

— Marissa
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

Alex — appreciate the quick turnaround on timing. Attached is the finalized RFI Appendix A and supporting artifacts you requested. Summary of the commitments and delivery options below so you have everything at a glance:

1) SAST/DAST
- SAST: in-house static analysis runs nightly for SDKs and weekly for the service codebase. Findings are triaged in our ticketing system; we provide an annotated findings export on request.
- DAST: our managed DAST cadence is quarterly for production endpoints; authenticated scans run as part of major releases. We engage our external pentest partner for authenticated & manual validation.

2) Patch SLAs (proposed customer-facing wording)
- Critical (P0, active exploit): initial triage within 24 hours; temporary mitigation within 72 hours; full remediation or formal mitigation plan within 14 calendar days.
- High (P1): acknowledge within 48 hours; remediation targeted within 30 calendar days (exceptions documented).
- Medium/Low (P2/P3): scheduled remediation aligned with patch cycles; advisory and mitigation guidance provided upon triage.
Note: For third-party/customer-managed components we commit to triage, advisory, and SBOM-sourced upgrade paths rather than absolute remediation timelines.

3) SBOM delivery
- Format: SPDX (default) + CSV export available; CycloneDX on request.
- Cadence: monthly canonical snapshot delivered via secure S3 link; 90-day snapshot archive available on request.

4) Pen-test executive summary
- Attached: one-page red-team summary (sanitized) with severity breakdown and remediation status. Full report provided under NDA and evidence playbook.

Next steps:
- Appendix A is attached and ready for signature: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/SLB-AppendixA
- If you want the full pen-test report, reply with an NDA request and we'll route next steps.

We prepared the artifacts attached: redwood_vm_rfi_appendix_v2.pdf, sbom_snapshot_20261015.csv, redteam-pen-test-summary-20261015.pdf. Let me know if you need these in CycloneDX or want additional timeline commitments for Dedicated instances.

Best regards,
